title: Outlander Charters

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Outlander Charters is a first-class charter fishing company, operating out of Sekiu, Gig Harbor and Westport, WA. Our boat and equipment are top of the line, well maintained and in outstanding condition. The Uitlander is an impeccable boat for having a comfortable, enjoyable day on the Puget Sound waters. A Rave Review from friends up North:Great fishing experience! We all watched the weather and picked a good calm day. You found the tuna school and targeted quality fish rather than quantity, which is what we wanted.Very good boat, quality well maintained gear and properly cared for the fish to preserve their quality.
